name: ics-tp4-e2e
description: Pruebas End-to-End (Postman + Newman) del flujo de compra - TP4-09

scripts.test:e2e: newman run TP4-E2E.postman_collection.json -e TP4.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export results/e2e-junit.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export results/e2e-report.html --timeout-request 60000
scripts.test:e2e:azure: newman run TP4-E2E.postman_collection.json -e TP4.azure.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export results/e2e-azure-junit.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export results/e2e-azure-report.html --timeout-request 60000
